main.label: 磁盘余量
main.command:
_disk_rows=$(
for _disk_path in '/' '/data' '/data2' '/data3' '/data4'; do
    if [ "$_disk_path" != / ]; then mountpoint -q -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null || continue; fi
    _disk_device=$(stat -Lc '%d' -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null) || continue

The main label sums readable unique block-device read/write throughput; children follow system/data mounts. Hover for read/write MB/s, read/write await in ms (including queueing) and average outstanding I/O requests (queue, not file count). Aggregate references include only currently readable unique devices, never absent future mounts. main.label: GPU余量
main.command:
tabby_gpu_value() { printf '%s
' "$1" | awk -F, 'NF { if(NF!=3) {bad=1; next} for(i=1;i<=3;i++) {gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/,"",$i); if($i !~ /^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$/) bad=1} if($2<=0) bad=1; used+=$1; total+=$2; free+=$3; count++ } END {if(bad || !count || total<=0) exit 1; printf "%d
",free*100/total}'; }; if gpu_data=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,memory.free --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null) && tabby_gpu_value "$gpu_data"; then :; else gpu_data=$(for gpu_index in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do gpu_row=$(nvidia-smi --id="$gpu_index" --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,memory.free --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null) || continue; tabby_gpu_value "$gpu_row" >/dev/null && printf '%s
' "$gpu_row"; done); tabby_gpu_value "$gpu_data"; fi

label: NAS磁盘

main.label: 磁盘余量
main.command:
_disk_rows=$(
for _disk_path in '/' '/volume1' '/volume2' '/volume3' '/volume4'; do
    if [ "$_disk_path" != / ]; then mountpoint -q -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null || continue; fi
    _disk_device=$(stat -Lc '%d' -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    case "$_disk_device" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
    _disk_data=$(df -Pk -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    _disk_values=$(printf '%s\n' "$_disk_data" | awk 'NR==2 {if(NF<6 || $2 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $4 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $2<=0 || $4>$2) bad=1; else {total=$2; available=$4; found=1}} NR>2 && NF {bad=1} END {if(bad || !found) exit 1; printf "%.0f %.0f\n",total,available}') || continue
    _disk_current=$(stat -Lc '%d' -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    [ "$_disk_device" = "$_disk_current" ] || continue
    if [ "$_disk_path" != / ]; then mountpoint -q -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null || continue; fi
    printf '%s %s\n' "$_disk_device" "$_disk_values"
done
)
printf '%s\n' "$_disk_rows" | awk 'NF {if(NF!=3 || $1 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $2 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $3 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $2<=0 || $3>$2) {bad=1; next} if(!seen[$1]++) {total+=$2; available+=$3; count++}} END {if(bad || !count || total<=0) exit 1; printf "%.0f\n",int(available/1048576)}'

description: 每30秒只读采样1秒；主标签汇总可读取的去重块设备读写速率，子标签对应系统盘和数据盘。悬停查看读/写 MB/s、读写平均延迟 await（毫秒，含排队）和平均在途 I/O 请求数 queue（不是文件数）。统计的是挂载点背后的块设备，并非该目录的独占流量；别名/绑定挂载不重复累计。MB采用1024进制。Overlay、网络盘或缺失挂载无块设备数据时保留提示，不显示虚假的0；不支持的设备不计入汇总。不做压力测试、不写磁盘文件。可选挂载校验失败时自动隐藏。颜色按读写总吞吐占参考带宽的比例：80%橙色、95%红色；显示值仍为MB/s。汇总参考只计本次可读取且去重的设备，不计未挂载预留盘。未知型号/预留盘采用180MB/s机械盘参考，具体型号及假设见README；这不是硬盘健康或繁忙率。

descriptions.en: Every 30s, sample kernel counters for 1s. The main label sums readable unique block-device read/write throughput; children follow system/data mounts. Hover for read/write MB/s, read/write await in ms (including queueing) and average outstanding I/O requests (queue, not file count). These are backing-device totals, not exclusive directory traffic; aliases/bind mounts are counted once. MB uses base 1024. Overlay/network filesystems or missing mounts without block counters remain visibly unavailable and are excluded from the total. No benchmark or filesystem writes. Optional mounts are hidden when their prerequisite check fails. Colors use total throughput / reference bandwidth: orange at 80%, red at 95%; readings remain MB/s. Aggregate references include only currently readable unique devices, never absent future mounts. Unknown/future disks use a 180 MB/s HDD reference; see README for known-model overrides and assumptions. This is not disk health or utilization.
